material_copy_sentinels.evidence_rationale: No visible contact marker, crosshair, flash, or overlay appears.
Both actors are abstract low-poly block mannequins with featureless oval heads and segmented rectangular limbs; this substantially dominates the visible presentation.

The camera is locked in a centered wide composition, but fixed camera alone is not treated as material copying.

limitations: The abstract segmented geometry removes hands, facial detail, and anatomical joints, limiting exact contact-point and foot-plant precision.
